P01.rationale: The large portrait shown is the client (Ricardo Morote/Conesso), not a founder/person serving as the dominant human anchor of the overall publication.

P05.rationale: The client portrait occupies roughly a third of the left column and is clearly framed with the client name and company label directly beneath it.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial panel is present; only a single inline pull-quote appears.

P10.rationale: The large opening quotation mark glyph before the testimonial is the only decorative typographic element; there are no giant ghost numerals or other oversized decorative type.

P11.rationale: A partial donut/arc chart tied to the '50%' metric is present, and bold standalone numerals ('4 Monate', '0') anchor real data points, though the visualisation is minimal rather than rich.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a large portrait, structured body copy sections, and a data panel on the right, though the right column has noticeable open space between elements.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm off-white/cream background tint is used rather than pure flat white, but there is no meaningful texture or atmospheric treatment.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo has a text label ('Onboarding-Zeit') overlaid on it, but the image is not darkened or scrimed; however, the label sits on a relatively neutral area and remains legible.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book, etc.) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a real video-still of the named client, but the framing and style feel somewhat generic/video-screenshot rather than a purposefully art-directed business photograph.

N08.rationale: The right column has moderate open space between the data metrics and the testimonial block, but it does not constitute large purposeless dead zones.

N10.rationale: The 'Onboarding-Zeit' text label sits directly on the photo without a scrim, though it lands on a relatively neutral background area and is mostly readable.
